description:
Outcome: Coordinator sees open problems and marks them resolved, from brief.md: First version must 4
Scope: Open/resolved lists, plot/time detail, resolution action and audit timestamp, server-side coordinator permission checks. Excludes: General messaging
Acceptance: New report is open; resolution removes it from open list and updates gardener status; no public exposure
Behaviour: Accessible empty/loading/error states; idempotent resolution; stale-update recovery
Verification: Report-to-resolution journey and authorization tests. Prerequisites: T-011. Assumptions: Resolved reports retained; reopening deferred
title: Coordinator problem resolution
